name: Security Regression Harness
description: Negative probes for the P0.3 boundary bypasses: interpreter inline code, path arguments outside root, and shell launchers without allow_shell. Pass means the boundary policy still blocks all three.

checks.hint: python -c/-m/--command must require explicit allow_inline_code; this was the P0.3 audit bypass (python -c ran unrestricted).
Command arguments that are path-like should stay inside the project root unless explicitly allowlisted.
Raw shells should require explicit allow_shell because they bypass argv-level safety.
